name: TensorPM v1.46.4
body:
# Changelog - v1.46.4

This patch brings the newest OpenAI and Google models to accounts that use their own API keys, and
lets you keep the chat and a task's details open side by side.

## 🎉 New Features

- **GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol:** with your own OpenAI key, the model list now offers GPT-6.2
  Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol. They take the place of GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol. If you had one of
  those selected, TensorPM moves you to its successor and keeps the thinking level you had chosen.
- **Gemini 4 Neon:** with your own Google key, Gemini 4 Neon joins Gemini 4 Carbon, Argon and
  Hydrogen in the model list.

## 🏗️ Improvements

- **Chat and task details side by side:** with the chat panel docked to the right, opening a task's
  details used to cover the chat. The details now open to the left of the chat, so you can read a
  task and talk to the agent about it at the same time. With the chat docked to the top or bottom,
  the details still open over part of it.

## 📝 Notes

- Updated libraries: the connections to OpenAI, Anthropic and Codex.
- TensorPM AI (the included service) is not affected by the model changes; they apply to accounts
  that use their own API keys (Business).
- No action needed. The update installs like any other.

---

## 📅 Release Info

- **Release Date**: 2026-11-26
- **Previous Version**: 1.46.3
